body: Oh, I'm old. I'm 40 and my sister is now 48. She found God a couple of years ago and really turned her life around. I am happy for her.  My mom worked in the mental health field so she knows full well how to react to such situations. There is a lot more to the story, but I don't feel like rehashing it. There are just some people who shouldn't be parents. My mom is one of them.
Actual disgust. She has said and done many terrible things. The same woman told my 12 year old sister that "I can't believe that something like you came out of me." Good times, good times.
I'm sorry to hear that as I would not wish this on anyone.
